abyssFlash.reason: Clean cyan starburst with faint rune ring, no fringe, reads as a flash and clearly beats the near-invisible shipped sprite.

bristleStomp.reason: Tall painted spike row with soft warm base glow keyed clean; reads as a stomp eruption and is more dramatic than shipped.

hoofCrash.reason: Alpha is clean but it reads as a teal whirlpool swirl, not a hoof impact; shipped streak with ground cracks reads better. Re-key the approved plate f269 to keep the downward impact column and ground splash, drop the outer swirl ring (tighten the radial key), or keep shipped.
